instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Build the exact instruction to write something from a writing recipe and the person's material, before writing it", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:compose-a-writing-instruction and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give recipe_id (from tool:list-writing-recipes) or your own recipe (instruction_plan.prompt_template: literal text, { block_ref }, { slot: work_item, path }, { slot: schema }, { slot: grounding, label } and conditional segments; optional output_contract, gate_policy, delivery_target, context_retrieval, work_item fields), work_item (the person's text and the answers the recipe asks for; missing answers take the recipe's defaults), grounding (source excerpts, each with its id) and blocks (your own instruction blocks, replacing kept ones of the same id).
